clarifications: Original author report is unmodified. Numerical panels update independently.
All source financial horizons are preserved; only2025–2030is reconciled.
The additional normalized-level TF-IDF variant used elsewhere is not used here; equal-level weights use the reported unnormalized mean of FP vectors.
The report does not provide the complete author dictionary or exact executable code. Independent token and feature-count differences are explicitly published.
